territorial_scope.description: Applies to electricity excise tax in Finland, as set by the Finnish Electricity and Certain Fuels Excise Tax Act.

evidence.quote: Tällä lailla kumotaan sähkön ja eräiden polttoaineiden valmisteverosta annetun lain (1260/1996)

summary.short: Government bill HE 156/2025 vp proposes repealing the Finnish electricity excise tax provisions (§2 points 6a–6c and §4a) that let data centres buy electricity at the lower class II rate. Data-centre electricity would move to the general class I from 1 July 2026.
summary.long: The bill repeals §2 points 6a–6c and §4a of the Electricity and Certain Fuels Excise Tax Act (1260/1996), as they stood under Act 1215/2021. Section 4a provided the reduced electricity tax class II for data centres (konesalit) with more than 0.5 MW of server capacity that met conditions on waste-heat use, ERE values or PUE values. Under the bill, electricity used in data centres would be taxed at the general class I rate of 2.24 cents per kWh instead of the class II rate of 0.05 cents per kWh, an increase of 2.19 cents per kWh. The bill proposes entry into force on 1 July 2026 and is linked to the 2026 state budget proposal. The explanatory sections also set out the background to the 2022 threshold change, the EU energy tax and state aid framework, the comparison with Sweden and Norway, and a separate bill (HE 97/2025 vp) on the mining electricity class. The operative text contains no enforcement regime of its own.},

notes: The document is the government bill HE 156/2025 vp, signed in Helsinki on 23.10.2025; the 'adopted' status in the metadata is not verifiable from the text. The entry-into-force clause in the bill text is blank ('päivänä kuuta 20 .'); the explanatory sections give 1.7.2026. The operative provisions are repeals only, so no thresholds are coded from the repealed 4 a § text (0.5 MW, ERE and PUE limits), which is not reproduced. Revenue figures (47 million euro per year at 2026 level; about 24 million for 2026; 16 million cash-based) are impact estimates and are not coded as facts.

thresholds.note: The operative text (Lakiehdotus 1 §) only repeals § 2 subparagraphs 6 a to 6 c and § 4 a of the Electricity Tax Act (1260/1996, as amended by 1215/2021); their wording is not reproduced in the document. The numeric criteria for the lower class II (server capacity above 0.5 MW, average power 5 and 10 MW, ERE 0.90 and 1, PUE 1.20 and 1.25 until end 2026) and the class rates (2.24 and 0.05 c/kWh) appear only in the background description of the current law (Perustelut 2.1) and are not coded as operative thresholds of this act. Entry into force on 1.7.2026 is an event, not a threshold.

definitions.note: No operative definitions in this act. Lakiehdotus 1 § repeals § 2 subparagraphs 6 a to 6 c of the Electricity Tax Act, which Perustelut 7 describes as definitions related to the data-centre tax support; their wording is not reproduced. The description of konesali in Perustelut 2.1 concerns current law and is background only, not coded. The jäljempänä shorthand in Perustelut 1.1 is not an operative definition.

obligations.note: The only operative section (1 §) repeals 2 § 6 a–6 c kohta and 4 a § of the electricity tax act; section 2 sets the entry-into-force date. The bill creates no new duties for any addressee. The statement that data-centre electricity would be taxed under class I (7 Säännöskohtaiset perustelut, 4 a §) is in the explanatory memorandum, not the operative text. Repealed provisions are not reproduced in the document.

enforcement.note: The text contains no sanction, fine, penalty, licence revocation, clawback, suspension or blocking provision. It only repeals 2 § points 6 a–6 c and 4 a § of the electricity tax act (1260/1996), and section 4.2 mentions Verohallinto supervision descriptively. Penalties in the parent act are outside this text.
